name: Leviathan's Wake
description: Summon the distant wake of a Leviathan. The wake arrives after your next action, crashing into the enemy with power based on a 1d20 roll.

creatureTiers.cast:
You reach into the depths and call upon Leviathan's Wake.

Something answers almost immediately.

Unfortunately, it sounds very small.
creatureTiers.warning:
A tiny shadow darts beneath the battlefield at alarming speed.

The water begins rippling.

You are increasingly concerned that this may not, in fact, be a Leviathan.
creatureTiers.arrival:
A determined little Wakefin rockets past your foe with all the confidence of something several thousand times larger.

Its wake splashes directly into them.

It looks extremely proud of itself.

creatureTiers.cast:
You call into the distant depths.

A broad shadow slowly begins circling beneath the battlefield.
creatureTiers.warning:
The shadow glides closer.

Shimmering fins briefly break through the Astral light before vanishing below again.

Whatever is coming appears to be taking the scenic route.
creatureTiers.arrival:
An enormous Astral Manta sweeps beneath your foe.

Its wings push a rolling wall of water upward, crashing into them in a burst of starlight.

creatureTiers.cast:
Your call sinks into the depths.

Something long begins moving far below.
creatureTiers.warning:
The water twists around the battlefield as a massive shape coils somewhere underneath you.

You briefly reconsider whether summoning unknown sea monsters was a responsible magical discipline.
creatureTiers.arrival:
A colossal Deepwake Serpent tears through the water beneath your foe.

Its passing sends a violent surge crashing across the battlefield.

creatureTiers.cast:
Your magic reaches into the depths.

For several seconds, nothing answers.

Then the entire sea shifts.
creatureTiers.warning:
The water grows strangely still.

Far beneath the battlefield, an enormous silhouette passes through the darkness.

You cannot see where it begins.

You cannot see where it ends.
creatureTiers.arrival:
The Leviathan passes beneath you.

It never even looks upward.

The wake left behind crashes into your foe with enough force to shake the entire battlefield.

creatureTiers.cast:
You call upon Leviathan's Wake.

The spell answers.

Then something else answers too.
creatureTiers.warning:
The Astral Sea falls completely silent.

Somewhere impossibly far below, a single enormous eye opens.

You suddenly get the feeling that this spell may have reached much farther than intended.
creatureTiers.arrival:
Something vast moves beneath the battlefield.

You never see its full shape.

You only see the wake.

The resulting wall of water crashes into your foe with terrifying force.

Far below, the eye slowly closes.

duplicateCastLine: The depths are already answering your call. Maybe don't summon a second enormous sea creature until the first one gets here.
echoActivationLine: Astral Echo activates! The wake echoes through the Astral Sea and strikes again for {echoDamage} damage.
ancientFlavor:
You decide not to do that again.

You will absolutely do that again.

easterEggs.bubble:
The wake crashes across the battlefield.

Your Bubble is swept backward, spins three full times, and gives a deeply alarmed *boing*.

Somehow, it remains intact.
easterEggs.mend:
The wake tears across the battlefield.

Several Fae leaves go flying.

The supervising leaf does not move an inch.

You have no idea how.
easterEggs.combined:
Your Bubble spins violently through the wake as several Fae leaves cling to the outside.

The supervising leaf remains perfectly composed.

Apparently somebody here has done this before.
